    ll x = 0, sign = 1;
    char c = getchar();
    while (c < '0' || c > '9'){
        if (c == '-') sign = -1;
        c = getchar();
    }
    while (c >= '0' && c <= '9'){
        x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
        c = getchar();
    }
